svg.title: Diffusion Policy: conditional action diffusion and receding-horizon execution
svg.desc: Illustrative inference overview. Two observations condition a shared noise predictor. Gaussian action noise is denoised from diffusion index K to zero. Eight actions are predicted, four executed, and fresh environment observations supply the next query at robot time t plus four. CNN with FiLM and Transformer with cross-attention are alternatives. Scenes and curves are schematic, not measured data.
